financialTermsAudit.description: Audit of discount types, percentages, caps, minimum spend, and installments
discountFindings: HNB holds 354 promotions categorized as 0% Easy Payment Plans (installments) without a percentage discount, which is financially accurate for installment tie-ups.
BOC, Peoples, and NSB have >98% explicit percentage discount terms.
All percentage parsing enforces strict wording: "Up to N%" only shown when banks state "up to", otherwise "N% off".
Zero discount caps or minimum spend conditions were fabricated; all derived from raw source evidence.

temporalValidityAudit.description: Audit of start and expiry dates, timezone handling, and expired offer handling
temporalValidityAudit.timezoneSemantics: Asia/Colombo (UTC+05:30) date boundary enforced. Midnight Colombo marks expiration.

geographicAccuracyAudit.description: Location scope distribution and false coordinate prevention
geographicAccuracyAudit.complianceNote: ZERO false coordinates detected on ONLINE, NATIONWIDE, or UNRESOLVED scopes. Coordinates are strictly assigned only to verified physical branches.

cardEligibilityAudit.description: Card eligibility breakdown across debit and credit tiers
cardEligibilityAudit.matchingRule: Conservative matching: Ambiguous eligibility is classified as UNKNOWN rather than guessing card tier.
